summary: Preserve successful writes when a later command is refused
body: When one shell call contains multiple commands, `commandTouches` applies the combined tool output to every split command. If a write outside the project succeeds and a later command is denied, the permission error turns the successful write into a refused note; because that path is outside the checked checkout, nothing else recovers the finding, and the workhorse check can continue without escalation. Classify refusal per command so a completed write remains a finding.

summary: Allow routine reads outside the project and home
body: A read from a path such as `/mnt/shared/...` outside both the repository and `$HOME` falls through this allowlist and becomes a reach note, making the stream check exit 3. The reach policy treats reads outside the home and project as routine; allow those reads while continuing to report writes.

summary: Resolve the full lane name when restoring a branch
body: If a configured lane name contains a hyphen, this greedy match captures only the suffix after the final hyphen: `wb/T-codex-lane` maps to `.worktrees/T-lane`. Restore then falls back to `update-ref` without resetting the actual worktree, so a reviewer’s reset or checkout there can leave its index and files at the post-round state. Derive the worktree name from the complete suffix after `wb/${info.ticket}-`.

summary: Escape recorded paths before inserting them in Markdown
body: An in-project filename containing `<!--` is emitted verbatim in the Reach block, so the ship-card comment guard rejects the card; a filename containing backticks can also escape the inline-code span and inject Markdown. Escape or encode path text before rendering it.
